parsed_json.up: Select the first 1000 IC50 activity rows for human single-protein target CHEMBL1293229 (Nuclear receptor subfamily 4 immunity group A member 1). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, join target_dictionary on tid, and join compound_structures on molregno. Filter where target_dictionary.chembl_id is CHEMBL1293229, activities.standard_type is IC50, activities.standard_relation is '=', and activities.pchembl_value is not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Order results by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
